verdict.rationale: Retell documents built-in post-call analysis: call success and sentiment scoring, plus custom fields synced to a CRM. It also offers a call_analyzed webhook event pushed to your server after the call, which covers the delivery path for structured post-call data. However, the evidence does not show how extraction schemas are defined or what the payload contains. missing for 10: documentation of configurable extraction schemas for entities and dispositions, call_analyzed payload contents, API retrieval of the analysis fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call

citations.quote: Built-in call success and sentiment scoring, plus custom fields synced to your CRM.
call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed events delivered to your server so you can react to call activity without polling.
webhooks push data to your application as events happen, making your integrations more efficient and responsive.
